cells.contract: Unique stable name + schema version. Handler takes context, TaskContext and typed args, returns typed result/error. Registration explicit, executable code never serialized.
Typed args validated before publish; dispatch opts immutable after enqueue. Result handle returned only after confirmed publish or durable schedule acceptance.
cells.field: Enqueue/Delay/ApplyAsync; Signature/Clone/Set; immutable signature; Apply eager test

cells.contract: protocol_version, task_id UUID, task_name, task_version, args JSON, created_at UTC, queue, retries starting at 0, max_retries nullable for explicit unlimited policy, trace_context allowlist. Body cap 256 KiB.
eta UTC, expires_at UTC, priority 0..9, workflow_id, parent_id, root_id, idempotency_key, correlation_id, headers allowlist, callbacks/errbacks descriptors, soft/hard deadlines, stamps string map.

principal reference and explicit scope ID, never passwords/access tokens; worker resolves current grants when task policy requires. Signed envelope optional authenticated broker path defense-in-depth.

max_retries=3 excludes initial execution; default_retry_delay=180s; retry_backoff=false; if enabled factor 1s, retry_backoff_max=600s and retry_jitter=true. AutoRetryFor empty by default. JSON only initially; result/routing settings explicit.

ID, retries (initial=0), delivery attempt and lease fence separately; parent/root/workflow, deadline, cancellation, Retry, progress, headers/stamps and worker ID. Redelivery does not consume explicit retry budget.
Hook error policy explicit; terminal persistence cannot be undone by observer hook failure; Replace persists continuation intent before acknowledging parent.
cells.field: BeforeStart, OnSuccess, OnFailure, OnRetry, AfterReturn; Reject/Requeue, Replace(signature), Ignore, Revocation; lifecycle signals

cells.contract: Unknown queue rejected unless declared auto-create policy; priority is best effort between available tasks, not preemption of running work.
cells.field: Routing: exact task-name routes then ordered patterns then default; queue declaration; priority buckets; worker queue selection; immutable routing options

cells.contract: Dedupe window/record TTL must cover replay window. No claim broker acceptance means execution or Redis fsync across failover.
cells.field: Producer reliability: bounded connect/publish retries with jitter; publish confirmation; stable task ID; expiry checked before retry; unknown outcome surfaced with task ID

cells.contract: No arbitrary remote code execution; control authorization separate from task enqueue; monitor event stream not authoritative result store.
cells.field: Events/control: worker heartbeat/offline, task lifecycle, retries, progress, queue depth, inspect active/reserved/scheduled/stats/registered; authenticated control API
